scripts.build: npm run build -w @ba/extension && npm run typecheck
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run build:store && npm run build:server && python scripts/package-release.py
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:ext && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
